summary: Zentek Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing the SEDAR+ filing of an NI 43-101 Preliminary Economic Assessment technical report for its Albany Graphite Project. The report, prepared by Micon International and dated September 18, 2026 with an effective date of June 30, 2026, cites an after-tax NPV of US$3.85 billion at a 5% discount rate, 27.4% after-tax IRR, US$817 million initial capital, and a 30-year production period. Micon recommends advancing to a Pre-Feasibility Study. This is a routine mineral project disclosure, not a special situation.
